blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists will see mixed oil price movements this week, with gasoline posting another hike and diesel dropping by about P3 per liter. In a media briefing, Department of Energy (DOE) Secretary Sharon Garin said gasoline prices will increase anew by P1.56 per liter beginning Tuesday. READ: Mixed fuel price adjustments expected next week Kerosene prices will likewise go up by P1.77 per liter. Diesel, meanwhile, will have a price cut of at least P3.01 per liter.
